text:
Picture a café owner in Scarborough. Her agency sends a 14-page report every month. Rankings, impressions, a pie chart.

She asks one question: "How many calls did we get?"

Nobody knows.

Count the calls and bookings your marketing brings in. That's the number that pays your rent.

Your Google profile says open 24/7, so you show up for a 3am search.

The phone rings at 3am. You're asleep.

Next morning: a one-star review. "Never answered." (Rough night for everyone.)

List only the hours you really pick up the phone.

The established competitor's biggest weakness: he's comfortable.

His Google profile hasn't changed since 2015. Same old photos.

You add photos of this week's jobs. You reply to every review. You write the service pages he never bothered with.

His Google spot slips slowly. Then it's yours.
